title: Seller row: input to generator.generate.generate_persona()
description: One flat object per seller. Every field is optional and may be null: missing values fall back to defaults and the affected persona choices are marked low confidence. Unknown extra fields are ignored.

fk_glusr_usr_id.description: Seller id (GLID). Copied into the spec as seller_id.

company.description: Company name, used to confirm the business by name.

seller_state.description: Indian state, e.g. "Uttar Pradesh". Sets the region and the start language.

annual_turnover.description: Turnover band; 1.5 Cr and above count as mid or large businesses (consultative persona).

business_type.description: "Limited Company" leads to the consultative persona.

eng_pickup_ratio_1yr.description: Percent of IndiaMART calls picked up in the last year. Over 50 means an engaged seller.

eng_enq_received_90d.description: Buyer enquiries received in the last 90 days.

eng_enq_replies_90d.description: Enquiries replied to in the last 90 days; 3 or more means an engaged seller.

avg_answered_call_sec.description: Average length of answered calls; under 12 s means a fast hang-up seller (brisk persona).

ctx_early_calls.description: Past answered calls that ended within 10 s (from the call log).

ctx_last_bucket.description: Trigger code of the last call (why IndiaMART called).

past_dispositions_detailed.description: Outcome counts from past calls, 'label (count); label (count)'.

past_objections.description: Objection counts from past calls, same format.

past_questions_asked.description: Question counts from past calls, same format.

asked_if_talking_to_bot.description: 1 if the seller asked whether this is a bot on a past call.

showed_frustration.description: 1 if frustrated on a past call (calm repair persona).

do_not_call_requested.description: 1 if the seller asked not to be called (calm repair persona; the contact gate blocks the call).
